turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Yes. First, one example.
This is ___ egg. Look at the first sound: "e". It is a vowel sound. So I write "an": This is an egg.
Sum up: "an" before a, e, i, o, u sounds; "a" before other sounds.
Right: I have a pen. Wrong: I have an pen.
Try it. Write a or an: She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
